name: VortX
subtitle: Native streaming app for Apple, on stremio-core + libmpv.

apps.name: VortX
apps.subtitle: Stream movies and shows on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: VortX is a native, open-source streaming app for Apple devices, built on the official stremio-core engine and the libmpv player. Multi-profile, HDR and Dolby Vision, skip intro and outro, stream ranking, in-app add-ons and debrid keys, and more. Sideload-friendly: this source delivers one-tap updates so you never re-download an IPA by hand.

versions.localizedDescription: 0.3.14 Beta 10. Fresh episodes now start at 0:00 (fixes the few-seconds-in start), remux playback and seeking are hardened, a large Android and web settings-sync pass lands, and trusted media transport is enforced at the app layer. In-place update over Beta 9, nothing resets.

0.3.14 Beta 9. Use a Mac as the engine, true Dolby Vision including Profile 7 enhancement layer, Dolby Atmos passthrough, Blu-ray subtitles, our own player engine, tvOS Now Playing, and working QR sign-in.
0.3.14 Beta 8. Same-day hotfix: Dolby Vision plays and starts fast, named audio and subtitle tracks, Singularity source details, and all four ratings everywhere.

apps.name: VortX (Apple TV)
apps.subtitle: Stream movies and shows on Apple TV.
apps.localizedDescription: VortX for Apple TV: a native, open-source streaming app on the official stremio-core engine and the libmpv player, with an in-process streaming server for torrents.
